mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO exchange_bank_branches ( bank_name, branch_name, address, latitude, longitude, business_hours, phone_number, is_active ) VALUES
( #{item.bankName}, #{item.branchName}, #{item.address}, #{item.latitude}, #{item.longitude}, #{item.businessHours}, #{item.phoneNumber}, #{item.isActive} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, bank_name AS bankName, branch_name AS branchName, address, latitude, longitude, business_hours AS businessHours, phone_number AS telephone, ST_Distance_Sphere(point(#{lng}, #{lat}), point(longitude, latitude)) AS distance FROM exchange_bank_branches WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere(point(#{lng}, #{lat}), point(longitude, latitude)) <= #{radius} ORDER BY distance LIMIT 20
SELECT id, bank_name AS bankName, branch_name AS branchName, address, latitude, longitude, business_hours AS businessHours, phone_number AS telephone FROM exchange_bank_branches WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, bank_name AS bankName, branch_name AS branchName, address, latitude, longitude, business_hours AS businessHours, phone_number AS telephone FROM exchange_bank_branches
